title: The Psychological Approach
summary: How management communicates with the therapist matters as much as the curriculum itself.

paragraphs: To make this programme genuinely transformative, how management communicates with the therapist matters as much as the curriculum itself.
The therapist should experience three important psychological shifts:

sections.title: From shame to responsibility
paragraphs: The therapist should be able to acknowledge mistakes without feeling that her entire identity is being judged. Focus feedback on specific behaviours and their consequences.

sections.title: From defensiveness to belonging
paragraphs: Reinforce that she can contribute meaningfully to the team while making it clear that respect, professionalism, and accountability are expected of everyone.

sections.title: From obligation to personal ambition
paragraphs: Help her see that becoming a better therapist serves her own future, confidence, reputation, earning potential, and personal development—not just Zura Spa.
